items.title_orig: What do you think of Eddie Vedder’s vocals?
items.article_text:
Eddie Vedder is one of the most interesting figures in music for a few reasons.
 One of which being that he seems to be one of the most divisive singers out there.
 Personally, I have been a fan of Pearl Jam for a while (they were my favourite band for a period of time even). I also really enjoy some of Eddie’s solo work as well. 
 There’s no denying he’s not the best singer but I honestly think some of the criticism he gets seems overblown. Is it really fair to say he isn’t good?
